tool.name: Annotate readouts with metadata
tool.command:
mkdir pycytominer_output &&
## Convert the input and the platemap to CSV for pycytominer #if $profiles.ext in ["tsv", "tabular"] python '$__tool_directory__/format_converter_csvtsv.py' -i '$profiles' '$platemap' -o 'profiles.csv' 'platemap.csv' -c tsv2csv && #else cp '$profiles' 'profiles.csv' && cp '$platemap' 'platemap.csv' && #end if
## Since the profiles and platemat headers are input as integers, they need to be converted in a a string columns_headers1=`head -n1 'profiles.csv' | cut -d, -f'$profiles_joiner'` && columns_headers2=`head -n1 'platemap.csv' | cut -d, -f'$platemap_joiner'` &&
pycytominer annotate
--profiles 'profiles.csv' --output_file './pycytominer_output/output.csv' --output_type 'csv' --platemap 'platemap.csv' ## "Metadata_" need to be add in front of the platemap header name to be read as input --join_on "Metadata_\$columns_headers2, \$columns_headers1" &&
## Convert the result back to TSV for the Galaxy dataset python '$__tool_directory__/format_converter_csvtsv.py' -i 'pycytominer_output/output.csv' -o '$output' -c csv2tsv

param.name: profiles
param.label: Input feature-readouts table
param.help: Table with features extracted from images

param.name: profiles_joiner
param.label: Column describing the wells in the feature-readouts table
param.help: Column with well values in the cell-profiling table (e.g., Metadata_Well)

param.name: platemap
param.label: Input platemap table
param.help: Table with plate map information such a treatment, cell line, and concentration tested

param.name: platemap_joiner
param.label: Column describing the wells in the platemap
param.help: Column with well values in the platemap (well_position)

tool.help:
**Joins a metadata file (plate map) onto the well profiles, adding columns such as treatment, cell line, and concentration.**
The plate map is a CSV (or any tabular format) where each row describes one well.
Documentation: https://pycytominer.readthedocs.io/en/stable/walkthroughs/pycytominer_cli.html#Step-2:-Annotate
